scope: Constructive native two-slot bank. Socket centres share X and are30mm apart in Y. Original socket, PCB, all62 fingers and electronics retain rigid placements and original Z seating. Each shell receives the independently owned returned polarisation channel. No copper routing or fabrication qualification.
units: mm; local slot0 atX0/Y0; slot1 atX0/Y30; Z retains original motherboard datum.
global_placement: The floorplan owner places this local module; no inherited case dimensions or AI/reference-image slot positions are mandatory.

selected_connector.representation: Retained own nominal native connector model corrected to published flush lug geometry. Real part, tolerance and contact mating qualification are not inferred from this nominal solid.

sources.identity: EDAC345/395series manufacturer datasheet hosted by distributor.

insertion_test_condition.interpretation: Manufacturer test condition, not measured force of a normal BMSX card or a new universal bank load/deflection requirement.

meaning_of_spacing: One physically bounded candidate with12mm shell-to-shell gap. This does not establish hand clearance, preferred industrial design or a required final slot separation.
mating_scope: Native contact/card solids retain their seated poses. Shell channel geometry belongs to design/cartridge_polarisation.json. All material intersections are reported; no overlap suppression or invented spring/contact behaviour.
not_proven: Whole mainboard placement or enclosure fit
Hand/grip clearance and card extraction in a finished case
Carrier/support and real connector load path
Contact force/wipe/reliability and PCB tolerance qualification
Electrical timing, copper routing, SI/PI and fabrication approval
